desc: Complete D48 process isolation and descendant cleanup for the A9 oracle shared kit's attributed lifecycle and reviewer consumers (slice finding F1), including the D53-moved collision and capacity-refusal cases. Remove parallel overlap from those supervisor-starting tests and apply the existing D48 cleanup shape only to their synchronous and asynchronous supervisor invocations through explicit call-site wiring or a distinct supervisor entry point. Add focused held-provider cancellation/failure and adopted-zombie regression coverage. Preserve every behavioral assertion, fixture, golden and production file. Run touched-file pre-commit before submission; submission runs the declared package and provenance checks.
done_when: Attributed supervisor-starting cases in lifecycle_test.go, lifecycle_linux_test.go, lifecycle_other_test.go and review_test.go have no parallel overlap, including TestOracleA9RegistrationCollision, AutoAssignID's capacity-refused body (oracleA9CapacityRefused), and its non-Linux skip stub; preserve the stub's D53 skip behavior. Only attributed supervisor-starting invocations establish ownership before starting and clean up on success, failure and cancellation. No unfiltered reaper runs in a parallel test or parallel subtest. Generic scenario.run/execute and scenario.start/launch retain their behavior for other callers, including PendingMergeStall's parallel non-supervisor CLI reads and exit_release_test.go's out-of-slice parallel supervisor cases; the kit change does not alter exit_release_test.go behavior. On Linux the existing D48 mechanism enumerates all actual children including adopted zombies, signals their groups, reaps with bounded waits and asserts none remain; non-Linux behavior follows D45 best effort and existing D53 skips. Focused controlled failure/cancellation tests prove live detached descendants and already-adopted zombies do not survive. No production, fixture, golden or asserted-value change; no blanket serialization of pure tests. A9 package tests and package-filtered regen check pass under env -i. Committed evidence records commands, tested SHA, outcomes and the unchanged fixture/golden diff.
scope: Only the A9 oracle kit supervisor execution/cleanup paths used by the attributed consumers in lifecycle_test.go, lifecycle_linux_test.go, lifecycle_other_test.go and review_test.go, existing platform cleanup helpers if required for reuse, focused new cleanup tests and the relevant A9 acceptance documentation. Includes TestOracleA9RegistrationCollision, the capacity-refused body and non-Linux skip stub. Reuse the existing D48 helper shape rather than inventing ownership tracking; keep ownership opt-in at the attributed supervisor call sites or a distinct entry point. Out: production code, fixtures, goldens, exit_release_test.go and its behavior (residual D48 concern recorded for global analysis), later runtime/C-task behavior, other oracle packages and boundary CI holds.
